implementation.publication: Existing global namespace and live-extent registries use AdmittedMap. No infallible namespace insertion, extent-vector growth/shifting or silent generation replacement. Final captured identity/current first-fit validation precedes relink; losing namespace candidate stays owned until finish. Exact release detaches original extent then frees after scratch unlock.
implementation.root_retirement: Sealed root metadata detaches complete scratch namespace/extent nodes. Existing ClosingAddressSpace/RetiredAddressSpace and bounded root invalidation custody retain them with root/slot/backing/authority/policy/original charges. Confirmation permits explicit post-guard node disposal before root backing/slot completion. Uncertain child cleanup still prevents sealing; no new physical proof or retry family.
implementation.mmio: Existing root lease and MMIO claim remain armed while scratch preparation leaves DEVICES. Descriptor/pages/claim revalidate before table work. MmioOperation::begin now atomically rechecks explicit mapped/unmapped expectation before in-flight publication, closing the prior preliminary-probe gap. Source-confirmed correction with rejection controls, not executed concurrent exploit.
